verdict.rationale: Kit's platform includes recurring-style features like RSS campaigns, Visual Automations, and one-time scheduled broadcast sends, and its MCP lets an AI agent read/write actions in a Kit account, but there is no evidence of an AI-native interface for defining or managing genuinely recurring/cron-like scheduled jobs or workflows via API or MCP. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP support for creating or managing recurring scheduled workflows, documentation showing automations can be set up or modified programmatically by an AI agent, independent confirmation of recurring job scheduling.
